C:P2.1.text: Powell Industries | Product Life Extension, Maintenance and Support

C:P2.2.text: Discover how Powell's skilled technicians provide electrical equipment services, switchgear maintenance, field service, and electrical commissioning.

C:P2.3.text: Product Life Extension, Maintenance and Support

C:P2.4.text: Thanks to a team of experienced, highly skilled service technicians and first-class equipment, Powell's testing and commissioning services ensure electrical safety and reliability.

C:P2.5.text: Powell offers a comprehensive line of circuit breakers designed for direct replacement for most major manufacturers. Replacement breakers provide upgraded vacuum interrupting technology as a direct replacement to air magnetic circuit breakers.

C:P2.6.text: Compatible with your existing circuit breakers

C:P2.7.text: Meets or exceeds latest ANSI standards

C:P2.9.text: Upgrading or modifying your existing equipment installation is a cost-effective, time-saving way to increase your system reliability demand and meet system design requirements.

C:P2.10.text: Powell's retrofit and retrofill products provide a cost-effective alternative to complete switchgear replacement when time is critical. Powell Global Services can custom design a breaker cell assembly to be positioned inside of your existing structure, match your control scheme, and custom fit bus work to match your existing installation.

C:P2.11.text: Cost-effective alternative to full equipment replacement

C:P2.13.text: Bus Duct Repair, Replace, Refurbish (RRR) Services

C:P2.14.text: The Powell Repair, Replacement and Refurbishment bus duct program keeps your operation competitive and efficient with the most up-to-date bus technology.

C:P2.15.text: Custom designs to fit to existing equipment

C:P2.16.text: Proper planning and professional execution are key to any successful electrical system start-up. Powell brings you decades of start-up and commissioning project expertise involving both Powell and non-Powell equipment.

C:P2.17.text: Supervision or turnkey start-up services available

C:P2.18.text: LV and MV switchgear and MCC services

C:P2.20.text: Powell has a breaker life extension program that includes extensive teardown, cleaning, and inspection of your circuit breaker; along with installation of the latest technology upgrades.
